label: 显示板

outline.method: Closed R3 rounded rectangle at original dimension datums, nominal dimensions rounded to two decimals as requested. Original imported Edge.Cuts retained on Eco1.User. All copper and component coordinates unchanged.

requested_behavior: 保留原电气连接、器件参数、位置和全部铜图元
电源符号转换为同名页面标签
原始板框保留在参考层
不移动器件或重新规划走线
source_vs_target_notes: Native 41 components and every source parameter retained; 29 have electrical pins.
Relative page positions, pin endpoints and wire vertices retained. A4 Y origin = 209.55 mm, a uniform -0.45 mm translation for 50-mil grid alignment.
Power-port glyphs converted to same-name single-sheet labels; colors/font metrics follow KiCad theme.
Rounded rectangles sampled at 7.5 degree intervals; text rotations normalized to 0/90 for KiCad properties.
Native pin electrical type is passive for all 85 pins. ERC cannot establish IC electrical correctness.
Footprint model names retained verbatim. Original external libraries are not present; do not auto-substitute.
Native designator * is preserved, including any KiCad annotation warning.
Native Altium compiled netlist and original PDF not supplied; use native geometric net extraction + PCB membership cross-check.

rule_translation.preserved_in_pcb: Imported pad mask/paste margins, solid zone connections, 0.254 mm zone clearance and rule-area geometry.
rule_translation.limit: Altium-specific autorouting, testpoint, collision and Keep-Out-layer scope semantics are preserved as source evidence, not claimed as fully equivalent KiCad rule translation. Default KiCad silk/text checks remain enabled.

schematic_style.label_angle: Style nonzero converted power glyph: 0; otherwise native Orientation * 90

revision_notes: 首次与历史目标比较后，补明原理图字体、符号线宽、引脚名称偏移及辅助铜形属性。几何与电气原始数据未修改。
PCB原封装字段统一使用原生 Components6/Data 的 PATTERN，不使用导入器临时库名。
比较显示总尺寸标注的方向、偏移、箭头和字体需明确，已补入 dimension_style；源属性名称沿用历史目标的 Altium_* 字段，字段值全部来自原生提取。
补充历史目标的编辑属性：有位号封装锁定、无电气引脚的机械/文字对象不进入贴装坐标表、隐藏源属性放在正面丝印层。NC焊盘类型来自本轮NC输入。
UL原理图圆角的历史转换使用整数字段，未使用半径的Frac字段；为匹配显示板目标显式保留此约定。完整原始分数字段仍在输入中，未修改。
